title: Power Dust
description: A mod that adds a power boosting item to the game, with a twist...
body:
A small, fun Fabric mod that adds a risky — yet powerful — resource to your world.

## Features
- Adds **Power Quartz** and **Power Dust**.  
- **Power Dust** is a dust you use in-game to gain extreme power for **30 seconds**, followed by extreme weakness for **30 seconds**.  
- A **Grinder** block to turn **Power Quartz** into **Power Dust**. 

## Usage
1. **Mine Power Quartz Ore**  
   Explore deep underground to find **Power Quartz Ore**, which is most commonly found around roughly **Y = 0**. Break the ore to collect **Power Quartz**, the base material for creating Power Dust.

2. **Craft the Grinder**  
   To turn **Power Quartz** into **Power Dust**, you’ll need a **Grinder**. Craft it by placing **iron ingots** around the edges of a 3×3 crafting grid and putting a **lava bucket** in the center. This new block is essential for processing Power Quartz into its dust form.

3. **Grind Power Quartz into Power Dust**  
   Place your Power Quartz into the Grinder and process it to obtain **Power Dust**. This dust is a special consumable item that can drastically change your strength in the game.

4. **Use Power Dust**  
   When you consume **Power Dust**, your character will “sniff” it. This gives you an incredibly strong power boost for **30 seconds**, making you nearly unstoppable. However, after the effect ends, you will suffer from severe weakness for **another 30 seconds**, so use it wisely!


## ⚠️ Disclaimer
- This is a **game item only**. The mod **does NOT endorse or encourage real-world drug use**.

## Mod Status
- Currently this mod is in Beta so expect a few bugs.

## Credits
Made by Dr. Floofers. Thanks for trying the mod — enjoy!
